parameters.name: AdjustType
parameters.description: 消费金额调整方向 increase:增加,用户消费增加金额 decrease:减少,用户充值减少金额 [必填]

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: 调整金额,单位为元,金额必须大于0。

parameters.name: OutBizId
parameters.description: 外部业务主键ID，用于做幂等性校验使用

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: 请求来源，填写系统名称即可

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi change-reseller-consume-amount --adjust-type increase/decrease --amount 10.00 --currency CNY --business-type quota_amount_adjust --source system --out-biz-id 1647396865 --extend-map example-string --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi ChangeResellerConsumeAmount --region cn-hangzhou --ExtendMap 'example-string' --AdjustType 'increase/decrease' --Amount '10.00' --Currency CNY --BusinessType quota_amount_adjust --OutBizId 1647396865 --Source system
